title: PhasMC's Creative Modpack
description: A Vanilla+ Modpack centered around stunning terrain, graphics, and quality of life for creative servers.
body:
PhasMC's Creative Modpack

PhasMC's Creative Modpack is a lightweight, high-performance Vanilla+ suite designed to transform the creative multiplayer experience. Born out of the practical needs of our own server group, this pack bridges the gap between client-side building tools and stunning visual presentation, making it the ultimate workspace for collaborative building and world-building projects.
🛠️ Built for Builders

This pack integrates the absolute pinnacle of modern creative tools, ensuring you have total control over your canvas:

    Axiom & WorldEdit: Massive architectural shifts require powerful tools. Command the landscape with unmatched editor tools and real-time building capabilities.

    Better Command Block UI: Streamlines logic, script management, and server automation with a vastly improved interface.

🏔️ Redefined Horizons

Vanilla generation is blown wide open with a massive, zero-lag overhaul to every dimension:

    Overworld: Powered by Tectonic and Terralith for breathtaking, sweeping mountain ranges, deep valleys, and diverse biological biomes.

    The Nether & The End: Explorable overhauls via Incendium and Nullscape, turning dark dimensions into epic, expansive landscapes.

    Distant Horizons: Enjoy unbelievable render distances without melting your computer, making huge collaborative build projects visible from miles away.

⚡ Next-Gen Performance & Visuals

Never compromise on frame rates. The pack is meticulously optimized for both high-end rigs and budget hardware:

    The Rendering Core: Powered by Sodium, Iris, and Entity Culling for incredibly smooth performance.

    Immersive Atmosphere: Ships out of the box with Complementary Shaders (Unbound), paired with Sound Physics Remastered and LambDynamicLights for deep audio-visual immersion.

    Network Optimized: Features Lithium and FerriteCore to reduce memory footprints and maintain server-to-client synchronicity.

⚙️ Installation & Usage Notes

    Environment: Optimized for both Client and Server. For the absolute best multiplayer synchronicity (especially with world generation and mapping), it is highly recommended to run this on both sides.

    Axiom Notice: For multiplayer usage of Axiom, please ensure you obtain the appropriate temporary or commercial license directly from their official Discord community.

Why we publicised this pack:

    "This is the first public upload of PhasMC's Creative Modpack, persisting across multiple of our own group's servers. After seeing how much success it brought to our internal projects, we realized this toolkit would be of immense utility to the wider Minecraft community. Build together, performantly." -- Apollo767
